annotations.title: Find an API, MCP server or CLI for a task

description: Find APIs, MCP servers or CLIs that can accomplish a specific task. Use this when the user describes a goal or capability rather than an already-known service. Call this first when a task requires an external service you do not already know, when you need an API for email, payments, search, storage, data, LLMs or another capability, or when an existing service is unavailable and you need an alternative. Describe the actual task in plain language (e.g. 'send transactional emails', 'find an alternative geocoding API', 'store and retrieve files'). Returns matches[] with slug, endpoint, auth, formats, rate limit, pricing and a 0-100 reliability score. Review the matches and select a relevant candidate before calling get_entry to inspect its full record. If coverage='none', do not invent a match: use the returned starting points or explain that no suitable service was found. For a known product, vendor, slug or endpoint, use search_registry instead. Agent Nexus only discovers and evaluates interfaces; you invoke the selected service directly. Rate limits: 100 calls/day anonymous, 1,000/day with a free key, 50,000/day on Agent Pro.

category.description: Restrict to one interface layer ('api', 'mcp' or 'cli' — see list_categories). Default: omitted, searches all three.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching interfaces to return, 1-20. Default 5.

min_reliability.description: Drop interfaces scoring below this 0-100 reliability value. Default 0 (no filter).

need.description: What the agent is trying to accomplish, in plain language. 3-300 characters, required.
